title: UAAP: 10-man La Salle holds off Adamson, grabs top spot
summary: De La Salle University seized the No. 1 spot in the UAAP Season 89 men's football tournament after holding on for a 2-1 win over Adamson University on Thursday at the UP Diliman Football Stadium.
